integrity.checker_role: finite supporting algebra, endpoint, and quadrature checks

scientific_limitations: Only Haar-random centroidal plane sections of the given regular three-dimensional tetrahedron are covered.
The theorem gives endpoint asymptotics and conditional local direction laws, not an exact full cumulative distribution.
The complete text of the motivating 2026 preprint was inaccessible; a residual priority risk remains.
title: Sharp two-endpoint diameter laws for random central tetrahedral sections
